verdict.rationale: The evidence shows OneDrive can share files and folders with people outside the organization. It also documents a createLink API for sharing links and path-based folder organization, which covers the basic shared-folder part of a data room. The more specialized data-room controls are not evidenced: view-only link types, blocking downloads, and seeing who accessed what (the only 'analytics' mention is generic marketing). Missing for 10: explicit view-only link settings, download-blocking controls, access/audit visibility for recipients, and independent corroboration of data-room-style use.
